proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a positive common critical-energy minimax profile over the entire original bounded table class, with all-design lower bounds, total Bernoulli and balanced reconstructions, an exhaustive arbitrary-tolerance evaluator, and a conservative n^-1/20 rate; math and decision panels passed. The package remained subfield (score ceiling 6.6 below field 7.4): efficient separation, a computed narrow full-profile certificate, least-favorable-state structure and operational planning evidence need substantial new research. tldr: For fixed bounded potential outcomes with public total pooled-energy floor \(E\ge\lambda>0\), the normalized standardized causal contrast has a positive limiting minimax squared risk \(C(\lambda)\). The limit is the proved paired inverse-energy experiment value and can be evaluated to every rational tolerance by a terminating certified arithmetic procedure. Quantitative lower transfer covers every ex ante law and every full-record decoder; total observable reconstructions under fair Bernoulli and balanced complete assignment attain the same value uniformly over the entire floor class. A dyadic transfer gives conservative \(O_\lambda(n^{-1/20})\) convergence of both root risks and squared risks. Efficient state separation and an actually computed full-profile interval of width \(1/100\) at \(\lambda=1/256\) remain open.
gap: Exact bounded-ATE minimax theory does not settle precision for the ratio \(\tau/\sqrt E\). Its linear-target transformations fail to preserve the pooled empirical denominator.
fill: A quantitatively transferred, evaluated limiting decision experiment would establish the attainable precision of this same pooled-SD causal contrast, with a matching lower over every ex ante design and every original-record decoder.
